text:
olivia_cs: Novapulse onboarding asked for SOC2 cert, DPA template, and a small sample of event traces to confirm retention/masking. They want this week. Thoughts?
mike_security: SOC2 ok to share. For traces: never raw. We should offer redacted samples or synthetic replay. Also need their threat model — why exactly they need traces?
tara_legal: Please request their legal contact and precise processing activities. We'll attach our DPA with a 7-day, auditable access addendum.
devops_sam: From infra: can export a redacted tar.gz of traces (payloads dropped, ids hashed) or create temp-readonly role for metadata only. Export job ~24-36h once scope locked.
emma_pm: Suggest a 20-min demo + redacted sample pair. Often enough for customers to sign off. I can run a demo Fri morning.
olivia_cs: I'll ask if demo + redacted sample is acceptable and collect legal contact. @devops_sam can you list which fields you'd redact?
devops_sam: Will do. Example command we can run: 
```bash
export-traces --source=events --since=2026-03-01 --drop-fields user_email,user_ip,request_body --hash-fields user_id,session_id --out=novapulse-sample.tar.gz
```
mike_security: Good. Add audit logs, signed URL expiry (48h), and require a Data Access Agreement. I'll draft minimal access terms.
tara_legal: I'll prep DPA addendum and a short consent for the 48h signed URL + logging/audit clause. Need their legal contact.
olivia_cs: Pinged Novapulse legal (cc: legal@novapulse.example). They replied: "we need to see examples of masking and retention policy. Demo + sample is fine." I'll schedule demo and confirm ETA for sample.
emma_pm: Booked demo Fri 10am PT. @olivia_cs please share invite.
audit-bot: Reminder: access windows must be logged; create ticket INF-4721 for the export and attach to DPA.
olivia_cs: Thanks all — will follow up once export fields confirmed and DPA draft attached.
